12 - Verify saving the Edit Profile form with a real name updates the Profile display — and confirms the banner bug from test 6 persists regardless
Uses a distinct, easily-recognizable name so this test proves a real change happened even if a prior suite run already saved a name here (see this file's own header). IMPORTANT for future maintainers: the Save button on this form is only enabled when the form is genuinely dirty (confirmed live) — if this exact literal value ever ends up already being the account's current saved name (e.g. because this suite was run twice in a row with this file unchanged), Save will stay disabled and this test will fail with a "not interactable" error. If that happens, simply change these two literals to a new pair not currently saved on the account. Checks the Profile/Contact display area updates correctly (proving the save genuinely works), while the welcome banner one line above it is expected to KEEP showing "null" — tying this test directly back to finding 6 rather than contradicting it.
